text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as Christmas drew near. Admire 
Vega handed me a piece of paper with a 
troubled look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
What do you think of this Christmas party 
proposal?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I got picked in the lottery to be on 
the dorm's Christmas party committee.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The proposal got approved, for now. But I 
just don't know. Is this really the right 
way...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I checked everything over, but found 
nothing wrong. Could her dissatisfaction 
simply stem from a lack of experience...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm not sure if 'dislike' is the right 
word. I just feel out of place during this 
time of year."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You want us to help prepare for the 
Christmas party too? Ah, I'd be delighted 
to accept!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The proposal looks solid, too! Leave it to 
me!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...H-Hey, wait a sec. Why these girls...? 
They're not even on the committee..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fact that they were her friends was a 
big part of it. I had an intuitive feeling 
that their presence would help resolve 
Admire Vega's worries.
choice_data_list:
You'll understand once we prepare 
together!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You're having a gift exchange? Then we 
definitely need some music to set the 
mood!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The present left in your hands when the 
music stops. It should be something that 
makes you grateful for that twist of fate. 
For instance, yes—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I can't play the songs from your Christmas 
concert. I can't keep going for hours like 
that.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I haven't even said anything yet! As 
expected of my dear friend and greatest 
rival!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I just thought that sounded like 
something you'd say...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thinking of your faves and 
decorating for them. It is just like an 
idol cheering fan...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sooo sooorryyyy!! The lights got all 
tangled uuuuup!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to cry, everything's okay. 
...See? I got it off.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Ayabe-san has helped me so much 
that she's practically gotten used to 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I just happened to have the opportunity. 
That's all it was...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...So precious.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Phew! It's really starting to feel like 
Christmas! Gathering around a feast, 
exchanging presents... ...Yeah, I'm 
already so excited just thinking about it!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You two... really seem to enjoy preparing 
together.
choice_data_list:
...Ayabe looked like she was having fun 
getting ready, too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Me? No way. You must have seen someone 
else.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, do you think so? It looked fun to me 
too, you know?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Me, looking like I'm having fun? Even 
though I never really understood 
Christmas?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Something is different from before. What 
is it—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...A day spent with these little ones, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It's nothing. I was just thinking that 
we have to make this party a success.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, that's right. For my sake, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The star shining atop the Christmas tree. 
Admire Vega gazed up at it. Her profile 
looked soft and serene.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It's nothing. I was just thinking that 
we have to make this party a success.
choice_data_list: Let's enjoy this year to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hey, keep your voice down. ...Geez.
